text:
Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Mid-Century 100% Stoneware Planter, 7.87"H, Dark Green
Colors: Dark Green
Materials: stoneware
This beautiful 100% stoneware pot provides dimension and beauty whether holding a plant or not. The small size easily fits on a windowsill, desk, or bookshelf, bringing style to any room in the house. It also adds a lovely splash of color to any decor. 8.85" diameter x 7.87"H 100% stoneware This mid-century 100% stoneware planter fits nicely on a side table, desk, or bookshelf. Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth.
